related_work: I was particularly interested in Eadweard Muybridge's photographic studies of movement. By capturing a series of photographs, he showed how continuous motion could be broken down into individual frames. This made me think about the relationship between continuous and discrete information.
conclusion_future_work: This week made me think more about how technology can capture and represent human behaviour. In the future, I would like to explore different ways of turning everyday actions into digital data.
results_discussion: Inspired by this work, I initially thought about recording someone's mouth movements while speaking and breaking the video down into individual frames.However, after thinking about it further, I felt that this idea was not quite what I wanted to explore, so I decided not to continue with it.Instead, I became more interested in how everyday human behaviours could be transformed into data and stored digitally.
title: week 2
introduction: This week, we learned the history of digital technology and how it can be used to record, analyse and reconstruct information. I was particularly interested in how technology can transform something continuous into separate parts.
